chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, raising it, said:
Amir Al-Momineen (peace be upon him) said: 'What is more excellent in seeking (livelihood) is the one who sails the sea for business.'
ai.seo_question: What does Imam Ali say is the best way to seek livelihood?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) praises the merchant who sails the seas, highlighting the nobility of seeking sustenance through maritime trade, a profession historically associated with risk, endurance, and self-reliance in early Islamic society. This narration underscores the virtue of lawful earnings (kasp) and the spiritual merit found in the diligence required for such ventures, aligning with the Shia emphasis on work as an act of worship when done with integrity.
